contexts.text: The reason Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, together with their company, were swallowed up by the earth, although they took fire from the altar, and offered incense, was that by their murmuring against Moses and Aaron was signified the profanation of the good of celestial love. For by Moses and Aaron was represented the Lord; and to murmur, that is, to rebel against the Lord, and to perform holy things, is profanation... AE 496:4. AE 727:11.
